summary: community.general 12.1.0 deprecations scheduled for removal in 13.0.0: the hiera lookup, oci_utils module utils, the oci_vcn module and oracle doc fragments.
questions: Is the hiera lookup plugin being removed from community.general?
When will the oracle modules be removed from community.general?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations: hiera, OCI
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated in community.general (Ansible 12.1.0), all removed in **community.general 13.0.0**:

- `hiera` lookup plugin
- `oci_utils` module utils
- `oci_vcn` module
- `oracle*` doc fragments
